en: A follower of the arcane are you?  Hmph!  Very well then... you can find them around the Pools of Vision underneath the Spirit Rise.
A battle?
Snarl calls me simple because I am too slow. I just want to do the job right, and that takes time.
Do not give up!  Shed your blood for Darrowshire!
Marshal Marris, sir.  Corporal Keeshan of the 12th Sabre Regiment returned from battle and reporting for duty!
You must choose a more experienced teacher, for you have surpassed my abilities. I advise you to speak with Lilyssia Nightbreeze here: she has much knowledge to offer.
$n has defended the stables!
The corruption of Felwood has trapped my spirit here... I may never rest...
Silverwing is ours!
Now, let's see... If I am correct, then... Hmmm...
The heft of an axe, the battlecry of your allies, the spray of blood in your face. These are the things a warrior craves, $n. I will carve out The Barrens with my sword in the name of the Horde.
Have you come seeking training in the ways of armed combat?
Jin'rokh, I need assistance in recovering a piece of my Vindicator's Battlegear.

I am not here because of honor, $n. I am here because of one orc's pride.$B$BIf I had not rejected Belgrom's offers, then I'm sure I'd still be in Orgrimmar taking care of real business.$B$BHis desire for women is not unknown to many of the female warriors in Durotar, but that doesn't stop him from being his charming self.$B$BHe's lucky he didn't pursue his desire for me much longer though--he'd be short more than just the digits on his hands.
Us hear and obey.
They say he can turn into a raven sometimes.
Um... sorry to bother you, but could I see Goodsteel's ledger again... if you're not using it.
Be ready, $n. I hear the council returning. Prepare to ambush!
I seek training.
Where is the key to this lock?
Read this tome I have placed before you, and speak the words aloud.
$n, how may I further your training in the eyes of the Earth Mother?
Captain Balinda Stonehearth leads the front line Alliance forces.  She is based in the Stonehearth Outpost, in the northern section of the Field of Strife.$B$BBalinda has been slain.
I need many more supplies in order to upgrade our units.
We need better representation from Stormwind.  Our homes are falling to the undead.
%s begins to moan and roar at Terenthis while stomping his paws on the ground.
Don't be afraid of the sword, nubling. It's the mutton that gets ya!
Don't waste my time.
What have you done,  Isillien? You once fought with honor, for the good of our people... and now... you have murdered my boy...
Hehe... I made a pun, didn't I? Druidic in nature... I'm so funny.
This should do it! At least it better do it!
Hey Jangdor - can you teach me how to make a Wild Leather Cloak?
Off to Darkshire then, I suppose.
I'd like you better if you would apply some perfume.
